rationale: The pediatric sulforaphane abstract gives interpretable effect sizes. Full values, preparation and botanical provenance remain open. The two separate registered comparisons have no posted results.
An independent fennel-drops trial pools fatigue in a nonspecific emotional domain. No fatigue-only contrast or toasted-seed Parkinson result was verified.

Three original adverse reports distinguish lower-esophageal impaction, probable allergic symptoms and airway obstruction. No original compares roasted shiitake on measured Parkinson swallowing severity.
The publisher preview confirms ground dehusked seeds, but gives inconsistent durations and no powder-specific arm values or isolated pain response.
The alternate thesis confirms planned force-platform visits. No numerical endpoint was found, and the trial article and registry disagree on exposure and comparator.
